page.overview:
Who is Cyrillia?

is the undead navigator on the Crimson Abyss, a ghost ship sailing the seas around the Shattered Teeth. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer.

Cyrillia was first seen as a female smoldering skeleton holding "some station" within the crew. She had a blue flame flickering in one eye socket, but the other was dark and vacant. She had little veins of smoldering light in between her bones. After she shared her warmth with Captain Novos, the glow of her smolder became a light grayish purple.

Cyrillia was morose and protective of her territory, although somewhat shy expressing her emotions.

While she was alive, she removed her own eye to prove that she was still good at her job, and even after dying she was good at it, being the only one able to see through the Fool's Curtain with the aid of a spyglass.
